title: MusicDrop v1.7.1 — TV Mode Auto-Detect & Icon
changelog:
• Distinct TV Label: Displays as 'MusicDrop TV' on Android TV / Fire TV home screens
• Auto-Detect on TV: Automatically detects TV devices, boxes, and Firesticks on launch and prompts with the TV Mode vs Music Mode chooser
• Header & Settings TV Switch: Easily launch TV Mode anytime from the TV button in the mobile header or in Settings
• Enhanced TV Hardware Compatibility: Support for Amazon Fire TV sticks, Google TV, and generic Android TV boxes without touchscreens
• Mobile phones remain 100% untouched
